recap.text: Carl's first pet box, bronze and stencilled with a hedgehog-like animal, holds a scroll of Heal Critter and ten pet biscuits. Outside the kobold boss room, he tosses one biscuit into each of fourteen caged danger dingoes, and Donut yells that it is her food. The baby mongoliensis pecks at biscuits like a chicken, and Donut promises Mongo a bow tie; he bites her nose. After hours of dog commands, Mongo waits for Donut's sic 'em.

Mongo reappears on the street with a pop, screeching and hopping in circles around Carl and Donut after Donut lets him back out. Carl tells him to get over it and tosses him a pet biscuit, which Mongo snatches in midair and growls over as he chews. Placated, he takes his place at Carl's right side while Donut leaps to Carl's shoulder.

beats.headline: Ten, then five hundred
beats.text: The first of Carl's ten boxes, a bronze pet box stencilled with a hedgehog-like animal, holds a scroll of Heal Critter and ten pet biscuits, a small pile of what looks like dry cat food. The last, the Legendary Pet Box, holds five hundred more and one enhanced biscuit. Regular biscuits feed pet-based classes for a full day, Mordecai explains. Pets find them delicious; they smell them and gobble them up, so only pull one out at a time.
beats.gist: Pet biscuits are the pet food in Carl's first box, a bronze pet box with a hedgehog-like stencil.

beats.headline: A betrayal most foul
beats.text: Outside the kobold boss room, beaten danger dingoes lie in cages. Carl has no Heal Critter scrolls left, but he has a ton of pet biscuits, which Donut still eats despite being a regular crawler. He tosses one into a cage. CARL WHAT ARE YOU DOING. THAT IS MY FOOD. The dingo pulls itself up painfully, sniffs, eats the tiny biscuit and turns its back, and its dot blinks white. They repeat it for all fourteen.
beats.gist: Carl feeds pet biscuits to fourteen caged danger dingoes, and each dot blinks white while Donut protests.

beats.headline: Pecked like a chicken
beats.text: The baby mongoliensis comes out of its cage thrashing and trying to bite. Carl has to sit on the ground holding it in both hands while Donut pulls a few pet biscuits from her inventory. It slows, eyeing the food, and when he eases his grip it pecks at them like a chicken. Its dot stays red. Carl, it's a boy, Donut cries, and promises Mongo a bow tie. He bites her on the nose.
beats.gist: Carl holds the thrashing baby mongoliensis while Donut offers pet biscuits; it pecks them like a chicken.

beats.headline: A very food-motivated dinosaur
beats.text: Several hours of dog commands follow. Attack, come and even lie down work really well; stay is another story. Mongo is very food motivated and loves pet biscuits, which makes him easier to train. After a full day he no longer charges at everything he sees. He snarls and hops, but waits for Donut's command, which has somehow evolved from attack to sic 'em.
beats.gist: Mongo, trained with pet biscuits over a full day, now waits for Donut's command instead of charging.

beats.headline: Get over it
beats.text: Donut lets Mongo back out onto the street and he forms in front of them with a pop, screeching in outrage and hopping in circles round them. Oh, get over it, says Carl, and tosses him a pet biscuit. Mongo snatches it in midair and growls as he chews, placated, then takes his place at Carl's right side as Donut leaps to Carl's shoulder. He really is well-trained, Carl tells her.
beats.gist: Carl tosses screeching Mongo a pet biscuit; Mongo snatches it, chews, and takes Carl's right side.
